prompt_text: I was in a car accident in Pleasanton CA. Which lawyer should I hire for my injury case?
competitors_mentioned: Teresa Li, Law Offices of Teresa Li
State Bar of California’s attorney search
answer_verbatim:
I can’t responsibly name one “best” lawyer from directory listings alone. A reasonable shortlist to interview includes:

- **David Duncan, Duncan Law Firm** — Pleasanton office; listed practice includes car accidents and personal injury. [Profile](https://www.avvo.com/attorneys/94588-ca-david-duncan-4469491.html)
- **Paulo Kline Simon, The Kline Simon Law Firm** — Pleasanton office; listed practice includes car accidents and personal injury. [Profile](https://www.avvo.com/attorneys/94566-ca-paulo-klinesimon-3563765.html)
- **Teresa Li, Law Offices of Teresa Li** — Pleasanton office; listed personal-injury practice and free initial consultations. [Profile](https://lawyers.findlaw.com/california/pleasanton/law-offices-of-teresa-li-pc-NTI0MTkyMF8x/)

These are starting points, not endorsements; online ratings and directory listings don’t establish who will be the right fit. Talk to at least two or three lawyers, and ask:

1. Who will personally handle my case, and how often will I hear from them?
2. Have you handled cases with injuries and facts like mine, and what were the outcomes?
3. What is your contingency fee, and who pays case costs if there’s no recovery?
4. What do you think the main challenges are in my case?

Before hiring, verify the lawyer’s license and disciplinary history through the **State Bar of California’s attorney search**. Don’t sign until you understand the fee agreement. If you’re still receiving treatment, keep records of care, expenses, missed work, and communications with insurers; avoid giving a recorded statement or accepting a settlement before you understand the full impact of your injuries.
